scenario: You need to ask a friend to move a meeting time.
learner_goal: Ask to change a meeting time and confirm the new time.
register_notes: Friendly Thai with polite-soft ขอ...ได้ไหม. Low-stakes personal schedule; no negotiation loop or workplace context.
